# Claims & Proof Check

`claims-and-proof-check` · v1.0.0 · Execute · Content & Copy
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/claims-and-proof-check/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Which claims in this copy need proof, consent or a wording change before it goes live?

**Inputs:** The copy to check, the audience (general, B2B SaaS, AI, EdTech or MedTech), and any evidence or permissions already on file

**Output:** A verdict per sentence (needs proof, needs consent, review wording, OK), every flagged claim quoted with why it needs support, what to keep on file and the regulator's guidance link, and a summary count

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill claims-and-proof-check`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/claims-and-proof-check/resources/claims-check.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/claims-and-proof-check/resources/claims-check.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It does not replace legal or regulatory review. It flags claims that need support and never says a claim is compliant or legal.
- It matches wording in the text you paste. It can flag a phrase that is not a claim in context, and it misses implied claims, images, charts and the page's overall impression.
- An evidence note clears a flag if it quotes the flagged words or names the flag id. The engine does not check that the evidence exists or would hold up.
- Its guidance links are to US regulators (FTC, HHS, Department of Education) and the EDPB only, and its audience notes cover general, B2B SaaS, AI, EdTech and MedTech.

**Review before acting:** Legal counsel decides whether each flagged claim can run. The founder or marketer confirms the evidence or signed consent is actually on file, and a reviewer checks the visuals and implied claims the engine cannot see.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/claims-and-proof-check](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/claims-and-proof-check)
